correction: Move the 'Serving qualification' and adaptive-depth paragraphs into §6, immediately before the seven-gate qualification record, and merge them with it: the model-class requirements (paged history + bounded recurrent state; iteration-specific caches; early-exit runtime path) become the first gate ('the model revision's execution path is supported end-to-end'), and the adaptive-depth paragraphs become the note on why per-token depth changes the scheduler's unit of work. §4 then keeps only the four telemetry habits plus one added item: 'record the model revision and the execution path in use, so a fallback (e.g. SDPA instead of paged attention) is visible in telemetry'.
acceptance_test: §4 contains only measurement actions; the qualification contract appears once in the chapter, in §6, with one vocabulary; the seven gates include the model-class requirements.
verdict_fix: Move qualification + adaptive-depth into §6.
